content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

The architecture behind selling courses without platforms like Teachable or Stripe is rooted in the concept of sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors, enabling creators to accept payments directly through cryptocurrency. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Pages and Workers, along with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators gain full control over their sales, retaining ownership of their data and products. This matters because it democratizes access to digital commerce for creators who have been sidelined by conventional platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this architecture are several key components working together seamlessly. Cloudflare Pages hosts the storefront, allowing for fast and reliable access. Cloudflare Workers handle backend processes, such as order management and payment verification. Supabase acts as the database for storing product information and transaction records. NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring that creators can accept various cryptocurrencies without facing the limitations of traditional banking. Together, these components create a robust, decentralized system that empowers creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where major platforms do not operate effectively. For example, countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan are often excluded from the services of platforms like PayPal, which operates in only 46 countries worldwide. By providing a sovereign commerce solution, COREMERCH enables creators to build and manage their online stores independently, ensuring they are not subject to the arbitrary restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts you in control of your sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of this architecture relies on several critical components. Cloudflare Pages serves as the front-end hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers execute backend logic to handle requests. Supabase provides a powerful database solution for managing orders and customer data. NOWPayments ensures that creators can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness, ultimately creating a seamless experience for both creators and their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling courses without relying on platforms like Teachable or Stripe, follow these steps: First, set up a Cloudflare Pages account to host your storefront. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers for backend functionality. Use Supabase to create a database for your products and orders. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments. Finally, ensure end-to-end testing before launching your store to guarantee a smooth customer experience. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a complete deployment package.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Cryptocurrency payments eliminate the barriers of traditional banking.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products if Stripe is unavailable?

You can leverage sovereign commerce infrastructure, which allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly. By using tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments, you can set up a fully operational online store independent of Stripe.
What is the best alternative to Gumroad for creators in restricted countries?
Consider using sovereign commerce solutions that utilize cryptocurrency for payments. This approach provides you with full control over your sales and eliminates dependence on platforms like Gumroad.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Unfortunately, PayPal's services are limited in many countries, including Nigeria and Ghana. It is advisable to explore cryptocurrency payment options through sovereign commerce infrastructure for more reliable transactions.
What are the risks of using traditional platforms?

Using traditional platforms like PayPal can result in account suspensions that hold funds for extended periods, with no recourse for appeal. This risk highlights the importance of alternative solutions.
How do I secure my digital store from outages?
Using decentralized solutions like Cloudflare and Supabase enhances the reliability of your store. Ensure that you have robust testing and monitoring in place to prevent outages.
Decentralized tools provide lasting solutions for digital creators.
